name: MCP Interactsh Bridge
description: Enables out-of-band interaction testing by integrating ProjectDiscovery's interactsh service as an MCP server. Allows AI agents to create callback domains, send probes, and capture DNS/HTTP interactions for security testing and verification workflows.
